summary: Source re-review recovered the missing row-level antimicrobial activity matrix from XML Tables 2, 4, 5, 6, and 7; linked DBAASP rows are reconciled against those locators with a preserved Dickeya/Erwinia taxonomy conflict; final acceptance is with cautions and no open rework targets.
adjudication_summary: Worker-6 re-reviewed the handoff packet, XML, PDF text, supplementary PDF text, figures, and DBAASP JSONL rows; the prior framework-test rework ticket is closed by source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair.

materials_exhausted.note: XML tables, publisher/PMC PDF text, OA package members, Data_Sheet_1 supplementary PDF text, figure captions, landing-page supplement artifacts, and linked DBAASP rows were reopened. No unsupported value was fabricated.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows were rechecked against XML Tables 1-7 and article metadata. Most rows are source_verified; Dickeya dadantii rows remain source_conflict because local sources identify the target as Ech/Erwinia chrysanthemi.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: All primary XML activity tables with IC50/MIC/MBC/MFC values were expanded into row-level records with units, targets, media/incubation context, non-detect thresholds, and source locators. Supplementary Table S2 is retained as qualitative in-planta context, not fabricated into MIC rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: CD/liposome and SYTOX permeability evidence are retained as direct membrane-interaction/permeability claims. Reference-only nucleic-acid or host-immune text is excluded.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_gate_decision: No blocking or major issue remains after owner-layer repair; the paper is accepted_with_cautions rather than accepted_clean because database taxonomy and comparator-sequence cautions remain visible.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP Dickeya dadantii activity rows match source Ech table values but the local primary paper and Supplementary Table S1 name Ech as Erwinia chrysanthemi.
SP10-5 activity values in Table 4 are retained as source activity rows, but no local Table 1/3 sequence row or linked database sequence exists for that comparator in this packet.
The paper cites safety evaluation in another publication; no paper-local hemolysis/cytotoxicity table is present, so no toxicity row is fabricated.
